title: Settle eight three-coset Hermitian bootstrap families at 784 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a scoped finite obstruction for the Hermitian bootstrap test graph: all eight native three-coset queue families have exact minimum cost **784**. This settles one precise part of Sudarsh Chaturvedi / Sudarsh3301's PR2956 Open next question 2. No new kappa or unrestricted Boot lower bound is claimed.

```text
native multiplier 118, line offset 81
  split paired vertices into three residue-class queues
  choose point-first or line-first alternation independently
  allow every stable interleaving
  exact minimum = 784 in each of the eight families
```

These queues allow both point and line orders to change. The predecessor's two-sequence result is cited context, not a replay target. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Philippe Van Velzen / philippeVV's limits-1/limits-2 and Discussion2278 for the graph, native order and bootstrap objective; credit Sudarsh Chaturvedi for the explicit continuation. Dynamic programming and regular-graph reversal are classical.

Only seven files in `research/pg16-three-coset-bootstrap/` are added. The written proof gives the exact domain and a bijection from all admissible orders to monotone prefix paths.

## Evidence

- Before: PR2956 leaves three or more interleaved sequences open.
- Result: the complete new domain has 49,027,896 phase/state pairs and 146,279,952 phase/arc pairs. These are DP coverage counts, not literal full-order enumeration counts. All eight terminal minima are 784.
- Eight reconstructed orders pass direct permutation, queue-order and earlier-neighbor cost checks. Their maximum prefix cut is 1568.
- A separate implementation imports no primary code, reverses every queue, constructs neighbor counts by positions, and retains two DP slices. It returns the same eight minima. The written regular-graph reversal identity connects its domain to the primary domain.
- The primary also agrees with every one of 2,256 literal shuffles across forty small graph/phase cases. Three invalid optimizer contracts and three independent reversal controls pass.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized checks pass, with identical generated hash-bound receipts for each implementation. The four individually timed registered commands took 12.034, 12.074, 10.921 and 11.265 seconds on CPython 3.12.15 / macOS 27.0.1 arm64. Each is below its 240-second limit.
- Metadata, exact committed bytes, source history and official export integrity pass. The declared external input is the predecessor's authenticated graph file; no predecessor scientific checker is imported or run. Optimized read-only, Git-free standard-library export checks pass.

Reproduce from the repository root, using the exact local interpreter path or a local CPython 3.12 equivalent:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/pg16-three-coset-bootstrap/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/pg16-three-coset-bootstrap/independent.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pg16-three-coset-bootstrap
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/pg16-three-coset-bootstrap --check-source-history
```

Add `--orders` to the first command to emit all eight complete witnesses. Both standalone programs are read-only and use only the standard library.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The result covers multiplier 118, offset 81, three specified paired cosets and eight phase masks. It does not bound unrestricted Boot or certify back-arc flow feasibility, schedulability or the imported code dimension. The source identifies q=16 as a test instance already below its target Hermitian rate; q=64 remains separate. No native/restored caller, complete paid/target invoice, compiler, precision/storage/tape proof or multiplication theorem is supplied. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Can a precisely changed internal queue order attain cost below 784? First exhibit a contract outside these eight families and its exact objective before further search.
- Can the q=64 Hermitian candidate supply a source-bound graph, code dimension, affordable order and feasible back-arc flow? Its complete physical supplier invoice also remains missing.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this three-coset order family or the PG(2,16)-M bootstrap cost was found in the complete cached open-body search and refreshed targeted searches. PR2956 is merged and supplies the question. This is scoped overlap coverage, not a novelty certificate for unpublished work or every historical diff.
